title: Stop Renting Intelligence: The Train-to-Deploy Loop for Specialized AI — Fireworks AI
talk_summary: A Fireworks AI applied-ML lead pitches their inference and training platform: custom CUDA kernels (FireAttention), speculative decoding, quantization, and three training flavors (agent, managed, API) for SFT/RFT/DPO, framed as a continuous train-to-deploy flywheel. The talk is mostly product marketing; the only transferable ideas are the eval-driven fine-tuning loop and the operational details around it.

takeaways.what_they_do: Before any training run they define evaluator functions and clean the dataset, then use reinforcement fine-tuning against that evaluator to lift quality on a specific task.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We helped them clean the data set, define evaluator functions and at the end of the RFT training job itself, we saw that there was 12% quality improvement

takeaways.technique: Speculative decoding with a trained draft model
takeaways.what_they_do: Serve a small draft model alongside the main model to propose tokens, trained on the customer's own workload data, to cut latency and raise throughput.

takeaways.technique: Train and serve on the same platform for numerical fidelity
takeaways.what_they_do: They keep training and inference on one platform because cross-platform numeric differences degrade model quality after fine-tuning.

takeaways.technique: Training agent that plans, selects base model/hyperparameters, and asks for approval
takeaways.what_they_do: An agent takes dataset + task description, outputs a step-by-step plan with base-model rationale and hyperparameters, waits for human approval, then executes and reports per-step status plus a summary and recommended next steps.

takeaways.technique: Hot-loading new checkpoints with zero downtime
takeaways.what_they_do: Swap model weights on a live deployment with one click, no downtime, so retrained models go live immediately.
takeaways.evidence_quote: when you have a new checkpoint ... you can directly go to live deployment without any downtime itself
